3. The present anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in F.I.R./Case Crime No. 349 of 2019, under Sections 3/5A/8 of U.P. Prevention of Cow Slaughter Act and Section 11 of Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, Police Station- Khorabar, District- Gorakhpur, with a prayer to enlarge him on anticipatory bail.

sentences.text: 4. As per the prosecution story, the truck no. PB13 BE 7886 was intercepted by the police wherein 32 animals belonging to cow progeny were recovered stashed mercilessly in it and four accused persons, namely, Saddam, Fida Hussain, Chhagga @ Chhangur and Siddhi Mohammad were arrested on 22.05.2019.
5. Learned counsel for the applicant has stated that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the present case.
He was not arrested from the scene of occurrence.
His name has come up in the statement of arrested co-accused persons although he has been arrayed in the FIR.
The said statement is not admissible in evidence.

Learned counsel has further stated that the applicant is a law abiding person and the criminal history of five cases assigned to the applicant has been explained in para-23 of the affidavit filed along with anticipatory bail application.

entities.text: Electricity Act, P.S. -Anti Power Theft (Shamli), District- Shamli
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant has stated that the first case is not against the applicant rather it is against one Wajid.
In the second case, he has no knowledge about the said case pending against him as there is no summons or notice issued against him.
In the third case, no charge-sheet has been submitted.
In the fourth case, the applicant was not named in the FIR and even closure report has been filed and the same has been accepted.
Learned counsel has further stated that the applicant is not an accused in the fifth case, as such, he is entitled for anticipatory bail.

7. Per contra, learned AGA has vehemently opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail on the ground that the criminal history assigned to the applicant has not been properly explained as no order has been annexed with affidavit filed along with anticipatory bail application.

8. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, the arguments advanced by the learned counsel for the parties and also the fact that criminal history of the applicant has not been properly explained, I do not find it a fit case to enlarge the applicant on anticipatory bail.
9. In view of the above, the present anticipatory bail application is rejected.
